urdu transliteration:
Hal min sada de kar dekha yeh Sarwar ne
Khud ko giraya hai jhoolay se Asghar ne
Mola ne yeh
Rokar kaha
Kaisa yeh sadma hai..... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
Sarwar called out, “Is there anyone to help us?”
Little Asghar answered in his own way,
Falling from his cradle as though offering himself.
The Master wept and said:
What is this calamity,
My son, Ali Asghar?

urdu transliteration: Aye mere dil, Noor e nazar\nKaisa ye sadma hai beta Ali Asghar
english translation text: O comfort of my heart, light of my eyes,\nWhat is this grief, my son, Ali Asghar(ع)?

urdu transliteration:
Lori kise de gi bechain hai mamta
Maan ki umeedon ka veeran hai jhoola
Ho kar wida
Hansta hua
Maqtal ko jata hai.... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
Who will sing lullabies now? A mother's heart is restless.
The cradle of a mother's hopes stands desolate and empty.
Bidding farewell with a smile,
He journeys toward the battlefield.
What is this calamity,
My son, Ali Asghar(ع)?

urdu transliteration:
Maqtal mein sheh bole fauj-e-sitamgar se
Dekho sitamgaro sookhe hain lab Iske
Be jurm hai
Aur be khata
Kitna yeh pyasa hai... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
In the battlefield, the King of Martyrs said to the tyrant army:
“Look, O oppressors! His lips are parched with thirst.
He is innocent, guilty of no crime.
Without fault, without sin,
How terribly thirsty he is
My son, Ali Asghar(ع)

urdu transliteration:
Khaime se maan boli ae Hurmala ruk ja
Gardan hai chhoti si aur teer se'h shoba
Teer e jafa
Phir chal gaya
Aur khoon mein dooba hai.... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
From the tents, his mother cried:
“O Hurmala, stop!
His tiny neck cannot bear a three-pronged arrow.
Yet the arrow of cruelty was released,
And he was drenched in his own blood.
My son, Ali Asghar (ع)

urdu transliteration:
Karte bhi kya aakhir ran mein shah wala
Chullo mein khoon bhar kar chehre pe mal dala
Phir yeh kaha
Ae meh laqa
Behaal baba hai.... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
What else could the King of Karbala do?
Scooping his infant's blood into his hands,
He spread it across his face.
Then he said:
“O moon-faced child,
Your father is left helpless and broken
My son, Ali Asghar(ع)

urdu transliteration:
Haathon pe shah apne gham ki khabar laaye
Bano ne dekha hai laash-e-pisar laaye
Chuma gala
Be sheer ka
Ek simt dhalka hai... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
Carrying the news of sorrow in his hands,
The Shah returned.
Lady Rubab (Bano) looked and saw
The body of her beloved son.
She kissed his throat,
The throat that had never tasted milk
It hung limp to one side
My son, Ali Asghar(ع)

urdu transliteration:
Shah ne kaha yeh gham kaise uthaoon main
Kaise teri dilbar turbat banaoun main
Baba ka yeh
Dil aur jigar
Ab khoon hota hai... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
The Shah said:
“How can I bear this grief?
How can I prepare your grave with my own hands?
Your father's heart and soul
Are now bleeding with pain.
My son, Ali Asghar(ع)

urdu transliteration:
Beta jo baba ke haathon pe tadpe ga
Bete ki mayyat ka dukh kaun samjhe ga
Seerat Hasan
Pyasa dahan
Sadiyon se kehta hai... beta Ali Asghar
english translation text:
When a child writhes and dies in his father's arms,
Who can truly understand that sorrow?
Seerat Hasan says:
With parched lips,
This tale has been told for centuries
The story of Ali Asghar(ع)
